South Korea.Title: The Vegetarian
South Korea.Author: Han Kang
South Korea.Review: Very strange. Made me crave meat in the way formaldehyde does.

Japan.Title: The Emissary
Japan.Author: Yoko Tawada
Japan.Review: Weird, delightful, melancholic. I felt like I was emanating a bright white light after reading this.

Brazil.Title: The Alchemist
Brazil.Author: Paolo Coelho
Brazil.Review: Vaguely magical realism. Found it a little heavy-handed, written with a certain unappealing matter-of-fact tone. The main character is very evidently a teenage boy, per his thoughts and actions.

Russia.Title: War and Peace
Russia.Author: Leo Tolstoy
Russia.Review: Tolstoy can always be counted on for a truly desolate and lovely death.

China.Title: China in Ten Words
China.Author: Yu Hua
China.Review: The writing in this book is really incredible, a mixed up work of pride and horror.
